name: Quickening Of The Church
overview: The quickening of the Church is a divine act of bringing spiritual life and vitality, accomplished uniquely by the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Scripture reveals that the Father quickens the dead and calls into existence what is not as though it were, demonstrating His sovereign power over life (Romans 4:17). The Son likewise quickens whom He wills, reflecting His authority to impart life just as the Father does (John 5:21). The Holy Spirit is the agent who quickens believers, dwelling within them to raise their mortal bodies and impart spiritual life, as Jesus affirms that it is the Spirit who gives life and that His words are spirit and life (John 6:63; Romans 8:11). Thus, the quickening of the Church is a triune work that restores, sustains, and empowers believers for faithful living.
